instructions: Use only apps/test_suite and tools-node/test_suite. Run headed Playwright with WebGPU enabled. Baseline and every experiment retain raw JSON, screenshots, work counters, and fixed fixtures. Do not run Windows, Android, iOS, or macOS validation.

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.
